name: amp-psrr
description: Issue #10: bandgap_top supply rejection with the offset-budgeted amp (design/bandgap_amp.sch) and DR-0001's cascoded output stage. Closed-loop AC transfer H(f) = Vref(f)/Vdd(f) with a unit AC stimulus on the supply, swept 0.01 Hz - 1 kHz (brackets the ratified DC-1kHz PSRR row from below); PSRR_dB(f) = -20*log10(|H(f)|). Reports the near-DC value and the worst (minimum) PSRR across the whole swept band.
claim: README.md Target specification, PSRR row (> 60 dB DC-1 kHz); see design/bandgap_error_budget.md Sec 3 for how the amp/cascode split contributes.

psrr_worst_db.description: Ratified spec (README.md): PSRR > 60 dB DC-1 kHz. Checking the worst (minimum) PSRR across the whole 0.01 Hz - 1 kHz sweep lower-bounds every point in the ratified band, not just the DC endpoint.
